text:
claire: Heads-up: doing a guarded enable for `ff:multi-model-routing` in ap-northeast during the quiet window at 23:45 JST (14:45 UTC). Low-risk ramp to validate routing logic + fallback behavior.

 tom: Plan?

 claire: micro-ramp: 0.5% -> 3% -> 10% over ~25m. Holds: 4m, 8m. Pin backend to `router:v5.0.2` for the cohort. Rollout JSON below. Auto-rollback on p95>200ms or error_delta>0.7%.

 claire: ```json
{"strategy":"micro","steps":[{"pct":0.5,"hold":"4m"},{"pct":3,"hold":"8m"},{"pct":10,"hold":"13m"}],"pin":"router:v5.0.2","rollback_on":["p95>200","err_delta>0.7"]}
```

 tom: Ops: please run a short embedding & route-map preload 10m before step-1. Also enable header `X-FF-Cohort=apn-quiet` so logs are filterable.

 ops-bot: Scheduled jobs: `embed-warm/apn-routes` at 2026-04-08T14:35:00Z and `route-map-sync` at 2026-04-08T14:36:00Z. Preflight checks: capacity OK, no pending node maintenance.

 deploy-bot: Rollout queued: `ffctl set multi-model-routing --env=ap-northeast` JobID: 90077 ETA 2026-04-08T14:45:00Z. Will annotate release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/multi-model-routing-2026-04-08.

 product: Added release blurb and stakeholder notify. Finance informed for cost impact tracking.

 tom: Add fallback config: `routing.fallback=single-model` to avoid request drops. Also enable `trace-sample=0.5%` for cohort.

 claire: On auto-backoff: deploy-bot will step down to previous step and add 10m cooldown. If a second breach happens, it will escalate to oncall and mark the rollout `manual-rollback-needed`. Manual rollback owner: oncall (currently tom). PM only involved if >40% traffic.

 deploy-bot: Auto-backoff enabled. Behavior: on threshold breach -> step down + extend hold -> attempt one auto-recover after drains -> if still unhealthy, open incident stub and page oncall. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ff-backoff-guide

 oncall-bot: Oncall rota: tom is current. Will page on escalation.

 claire: Final checklist: pin router:v5.0.2, set micro-ramp payload, schedule warmups, set headers/traces, set alerts, confirm oncall. Starting in ~12m.

 tom: SGTM. I'll monitor SLOs and be ready to rollback `ffctl rollback multi-model-routing --to=0%` if needed.

 claire: Thanks — if anything suspicious early, prefer erring on rollback and capture traces for postmortem.
